_README: The marketing team's source of truth: what we may say we do, where we say
we do it, who we say it to, and what we may never claim.
VERSION CONTROL: this file lives in the REPO and is read from the repo by
config.load_marketing_profile(). It is deliberately NOT copied to
AGENTS_DATA_DIR. Volume-seeded config (price_book.json and friends) is
copied only when absent, so on a long-lived volume the repo copy goes inert
and editing it changes nothing in production. This file has the opposite
behaviour on purpose: edit here, commit, deploy, and it is live. Git log is
TO UPDATE: edit, bump `version`, set `last_reviewed` to today, commit.
`cd agents && pytest` fails if the shape is wrong. No process restart is
needed locally — the loader re-reads on every call.
Sections marked "volatile": true are expected to churn and should be

review.note: phrases_to_avoid and provable_differentiators drive the review; the rest changes rarely.

company.name: Project One Roofing
company.website_note: Changed from projectoneroofing.com on 2026-08-10. The EMAIL domain is still @projectoneroofing.com and is a separate thing — see portal/users.py EMAIL_DOMAIN.

approved_services.rule: Marketing copy may only offer work named here. A service not on this list must not be implied, bundled, or teased, even if a competitor or a trending topic centers on it.

categories.label: Roofing
categories.note: All flat roof work is in scope, residential and commercial alike.

service_area.description: All of Colorado east of the mountains.
service_area.boundary_note: Eastern Colorado — the Front Range and the plains. Copy should not promise service on the Western Slope or in the mountain resort corridor.
service_area.open_question: OPEN: 'east of the mountains' has not been pinned to a boundary. The existing rep territories in agents/config.py include Woodland Park (Teller) and Cañon City (Fremont), which sit in or against the foothills. Resolve before any copy names a town near the line; the examples above are the ones that are unambiguous.
service_area.cross_reference: agents/config.py DEFAULT_SETTINGS.service_area_counties is a NARROWER list used only for ICP scoring boosts on B2B leads. It is not the marketing claimable area and the two are allowed to differ.

target_customers.rule: A starting list, not a fence. A customer type absent from this list is not disqualified — treat an unlisted but plausible audience as in scope and flag it for a future addition here.

phrases_to_avoid.rule: Case-insensitive whole-word match. A draft containing one of these must be rewritten, not shipped with the phrase softened.
phrases_to_avoid.note: Expected to grow often. Add the reason when it is known — an entry with an empty reason is still enforced.

provable_differentiators.rule: The ONLY claims of superiority marketing copy may make. This list is intentionally empty until each entry has evidence behind it. While it is empty, agents must write copy that makes no comparative or superiority claim at all — an empty list means 'none proven yet', never 'use your judgement'.
provable_differentiators.note: Each entry carries its own proof, so a reviewer can check the claim without leaving this file. Enforced by test_every_differentiator_carries_its_proof.

entry_shape.claim: the sentence copy is allowed to assert
entry_shape.proof: what backs it — a number, a document, a source we can point at

licensing.statement: Licensed in all local jurisdictions we serve.
licensing.note: Stated as a blanket claim by the company. Per-jurisdiction licence numbers are not tracked here; the estimator's jurisdictions.json is the permit-side reference and is a separate concern.

credentials.rule: Name only the accreditations listed here, spelled as written. Do not upgrade an accreditation into a superlative (e.g. a manufacturer credential is not 'the highest certification available') unless that upgrade is listed under provable_differentiators with proof.
